title: WCLI-123 review follow-ups: harden the sign-step tests and fix the runbook and stale-text nits (non-blocking)
description: Non-blocking findings from the Opus review of opum-ai/ward-cli#246 (merged as 3e73ac8). To be briefed later; not started. (a) The sign step soft-fail gap: set +e, or an ERR trap that runs exit 0, after set -euo pipefail leaves every test green; assert that the sign step run has no "set +" and no trap. (b) N3 gap: a || turned into && in the cdhash guard stays green because the test checks substrings; assert the whole line if [ -z "$signed" ] || [ "$signed" != "$computed" ]. (c) Stale flip text at test/release-workflow.test.ts lines 692-693 and scripts/verify-published-release.sh lines 3-4. (d) N4 wording at the publish runbook lines 35-36: a failing release-job sha256sum check publishes nothing, and step 3 then fails on the missing notes; cmp -s plus shasum -c catch a bad PUBLISHED checksum; move the v0.1.0-only marker onto step 6 itself. (e) Have the runbook compare the RUN headSha with the tag commit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The sign step test rejects a set +e and an ERR trap, shown red by mutation
The cdhash guard test asserts the whole if line, shown red by an || to && mutation
The stale flip wording in the test and in verify-published-release.sh is corrected
The publish runbook N4 wording is accurate and the v0.1.0-only marker is on step 6
The runbook compares the run headSha with the tag commit before verifying
